intro:
Six channels, each with a codename. The codename is the point: in the field you say "go to Bamboo" and everyone turns one knob, which is the only channel plan that survives cold hands and a bad signal. Write the two you are using on tape on the back of each radio.

Ginkgo, Bamboo and Lotus are on the 409 MHz 公众对讲机 band, and for most groups in China they are the answer: the radios are sold everywhere for the price of a meal and work out of the box. Pine, Poplar and Bluestone are the amateur bands, which reach many times further but need the handhelds to match. One thing that catches visitors out: American channels do not work here. China's 2 m allocation stops at 146.000 and 70 cm stops at 440.000, so 146.520, 446.100 and everything on 1.25 m fall outside the band. Build a separate memory bank rather than hunting for a set that works in both countries — there isn't one.
introz:
六个频率，每个都有一个代号。代号才是重点：在野外你只需要说「切到翠竹」，所有人拧一下旋钮就行——在手冻僵、信号又差的时候，只有这种方案撑得住。把正在用的两个频率写在胶带上，贴到每台电台背面。

银杏、翠竹和青莲在 409 MHz 公众对讲机频段上，对国内大多数队伍来说这就是答案：电台随处有售，价格跟一顿饭差不多，开机就能用。红松、胡杨和青石在业余频段上，距离远好几倍，但手台得对得上。有一条容易让外来者踩坑：美国的频率在这里不能用。中国的 2 米划分到 146.000 为止，70 厘米到 440.000 为止，所以 146.520、446.100 以及 1.25 米的一切都落在频段之外。建一组独立的存储分区，不要指望找到一套两国通用的频率——不存在。

stations.n: Ginkgo · everyday, on the radios everyone has
stations.z: 银杏 · 日常，用人人都有的那种机器
stations.a: Anyone's radio — 公众对讲机 409 MHz
stations.d: Channel 19, near the top of the band. Cheap radios leave the factory on Channel 1 and most people never change it, so the last few channels are reliably the quietest in the country. Add the DCS code and you will effectively never hear a stranger. Expect a few hundred metres in a city and a few kilometres with clear line of sight — 0.5 W and a fixed antenna is all this band allows. 409 MHz is outside the VX-6R's transmit range, so buy a pair of consumer radios for the group; the VX-6 can still listen, which is genuinely useful for finding a quiet channel before you commit to one.
stations.dz: 19 频道，接近频段顶端。廉价电台出厂停在 1 频道，大多数人从不改，所以最后几个信道一直是全国最安静的。再加上 DCS 码，基本不会听到陌生人。城里能通几百米，视野开阔时几公里——这个频段只允许 0.5 瓦和固定天线。409 MHz 不在 VX-6R 的发射范围内，所以给队伍买一对民用对讲机；VX-6 仍然可以收听，在选定信道之前先听听哪个安静，其实很有用。

stations.a: Anyone's radio — 公众对讲机 409 MHz
stations.d: Channel 20, the last in the band. Same DCS code, so switching costs nothing. Agree the rule before you split up: if you lose each other on Ginkgo, go to Bamboo, and if that fails go back to Ginkgo and call every five minutes.
stations.dz: 20 频道，频段最后一个。DCS 码相同，切换没有任何成本。分头行动前先约定好规则：在银杏上失联就切翠竹，翠竹也不行就回到银杏，每五分钟呼叫一次。

stations.n: Lotus · second backup, or a second group
stations.z: 青莲 · 第二备频，或另一支队伍
stations.a: Anyone's radio — 公众对讲机 409 MHz
stations.d: Channel 17. Useful when a large party splits into two groups that each need a channel of their own but still want to reach the other.
stations.dz: 17 频道。当一支大队伍分成两组、各自需要一个频率又要能互相联系时很有用。

stations.z: 红松 · 开阔地与山脊
stations.d: If your group is on amateur handhelds, this reaches many times further than 409 MHz and is the right choice in the mountains. China follows the IARU Region 3 plan, where FM simplex runs roughly 145.200–145.575 MHz with 145.500 as the calling channel; 145.250 keeps clear of both that and the repeater sub-bands. Regional practice varies more here than in the US, so confirm with the local 无线电协会.
stations.dz: 如果队伍用的是业余手台，这个频段的距离是 409 MHz 的好几倍，在山区是正确的选择。中国遵循 IARU 第三区规划，FM 直通段大致在 145.200–145.575 MHz，145.500 为呼叫频率；145.250 既避开呼叫频率，也避开中继台子频段。各地实际做法的差异比美国大，请向当地无线电协会确认。

stations.d: Same band and DCS code as Pine.
stations.dz: 与红松同波段、同 DCS 码。

stations.a: Amateur bands — 70 cm (430–440 MHz), ask locally first
stations.d: UHF gets through walls and around street corners better than 2 m, so this is the city and indoor choice. One real caveat: the widely used convention puts repeater outputs around 439 MHz with inputs 5 MHz below, so a simplex channel here can land on top of a machine. Listen for a minute before you use it, and ask locally before you settle on it. Stay off 433 MHz entirely — 433.050–434.790 is the short-range device band, full of car key fobs, doorbells and tyre sensors, and is the noisiest stretch of UHF in the country.
stations.dz: UHF 穿墙、绕街角的能力优于 2 米，所以城市和室内选它。有一条实在的注意事项：普遍的惯例是中继台下行在 439 MHz 附近、上行低 5 MHz，所以在这里开直通有可能压住某台中继。使用前先听一分钟，定频之前先问当地。另外完全不要碰 433 MHz——433.050–434.790 是短距离设备频段，塞满了车钥匙、门铃和胎压传感器，是国内噪声最大的一段 UHF。
